name: dsh-math-tex
title: dsh-math-tex — math output repair
description: Prompt rules plus a pre-persistence stream guard that repairs any math region the renderer would paint red.

options.promptRules: How much of the formatting rule set reaches the system prompt: full | minimal | off.
options.repair: auto rewrites a broken region; check-only logs it; off passes everything through.
options.tailBuffer: Smallest suffix of text held back so a completion marker cannot leak character by character.
options.maxHold: Longest a single unclosed math region may wait before the text is released unrepaired.
options.logFile: Diagnostic log path. Empty means the host logger only.
options.katexPath: Pin the KaTeX build used for judging; by default it is resolved from the host profile.
options.macros: Macros handed to the renderer, to match the client's behaviour.
